tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: Primary and darkest color. Primary buttons, headings, active nav, text on sage, cream and paper. Cream text on it is 12.8:1.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Page background. Text on it: ink, ink-muted, forest.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Secondary surface: quiet panels, message previews, selected rows, the Experienced badge. Text on it: ink, ink-muted, forest.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Accent, used sparingly: the suggestion spark, the New badge fill, one highlight per screen. Decorative fill only: never as text or a thin line on cream or paper (2.2:1); use gold-deep for those. Forest on gold is 5.9:1.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Card surface lifted off cream. Text on it: ink, ink-muted, forest.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text on cream, paper and sage (7.2, 7.8 and 6.6:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Reasons, captions and secondary lines on cream, paper and sage (5.1, 5.5 and 4.7:1). Never lighter than this for text.

tokens.name: gold-deep
tokens.usage: Gold for text and thin marks: kicker words, a gold-toned icon or rule on cream, paper and sage. Use instead of gold wherever it must be read.

tokens.name: gold-soft
tokens.usage: Light gold for accents on forest surfaces and highlights. Forest on gold-soft is high contrast; never text on cream.

tokens.name: forest-deep
tokens.usage: Slightly lighter forest for raised panels on forest.

tokens.name: forest-mid
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for forest, dividers on forest.

tokens.name: sage-deep
tokens.usage: Selected or pressed sage, pill outlines and progress tracks.

tokens.name: on-forest
tokens.usage: Text and icons on forest.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairline between rows and around cards. Carries no meaning on its own.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls (secondary button, chips, inputs) and meaningful icons. 3.8:1 on cream.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring on light surfaces: 3px solid, 2px offset. On forest surfaces use gold.

tokens.name: status-ok-bg
tokens.usage: Background of a calm, done or confirmed status tag. Pair with status-ok-ink, a check icon and a word.

tokens.name: status-ok-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icon on status-ok-bg (5.2:1) and on paper (6.2:1).

tokens.name: status-attn-bg
tokens.usage: Background of a heads-up: shared volunteer, above preference, empty slot. Pair with an alert icon and a word.

tokens.name: status-attn-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icon on status-attn-bg (5.0:1) and on paper (6.0:1).

tokens.name: status-alert-bg
tokens.usage: Background of a failure: a reminder that did not send. Pair with an alert icon and a word. Used rarely.

tokens.name: status-alert-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icon on status-alert-bg (5.5:1) and on paper (6.8:1).

styles.name: t-display
styles.usage: Screen greeting and briefing headline: "Kids Ministry: 3 things need you this week".

styles.name: t-h3
styles.usage: Person names, group headers (Habits, Growth notes).

styles.name: t-caption
styles.usage: Badges, "Used in 3 suggestions", footer notes. Always ink-muted or stronger.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge inner gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related lines; chip gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding, gap between a card's text and its buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile screen gutter, card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between cards; desktop card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page top and bottom breathing room on desktop.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tapped with a thumb.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inline flags, message previews, skeleton bars.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Rows, inputs, notices.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, badges, tags, time-slot chips, tab segments.

shadow.note: Almost none. Cards are separated by a hairline and a whisper of shadow, never a lift.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards on cream. Nothing heavier anywhere.
